preservedResponsibilities: Emits represented native Writer paragraph and character item controls, including first-line indent, upper/lower/contextual spacing, four source line-spacing modes and measured script-font leading, keep/split/widow behavior, tab alignment/leader/position, page-break-before, strikeout and escapement.
Emits the pinned underline style controls, word-only single underline and ulc color-table index from native underline items.
Emits direct automatic character color as cf0 and highlight via the fixed Word palette and msfilter::util::TransColToIco, including native brush colors projected with alpha.

Owns shared source OutTBLBorderLine and OutBorderLine emission for cells and paragraph FormatBox, including uniform box form, explicit no-border overrides, native border styles, color indices, distances and the source thick-width flag.

Emits native Western font height with integral half-point truncation, posture with the source non-NONE comparison, weight only for exact WEIGHT_BOLD, explicit font resets and native auto-kerning independently from the browser character projection.

Native WriteNativeCharacter now delegates original associated-group ordering rather than emitting only Western fonts. Basic underline keywords move to the source association stage while non-associated underline color remains before it. All three native language values are emitted in their original families. Source caller collection uses a temporary actual set without mutating the borrowed input; native run script/bidi production and full paragraph-marker/general-property owners remain open.

Native non-associated OutputCharFontAssoc updates the actual RtfExport current encoding through FontMapExport and checked font charset selection, with original unknown-to-default fallback; associated font output leaves encoding unchanged. Native RunText ignores its supplied charset and delegates RawText/OutString using current export encoding. RTF text uses represented GetSnippet substitutions; style names and hyperlink values use OutString.

FontFamilyType, FontPitchType, FontCharset, StartFont, FontAlternateName and EndFont write to the actual export SvStream. Associated font controls now borrow the complete SvxFontItem rather than only its name.

S3HW1E RTF numbering-table integration: actual GetNumberingId pointer identity and the InitFontTable used-rule snapshot replace the separate name-keyed RTF list map. Original abstract/instance loops emit nine Word levels or one continuous level, including the actual outline owner. Source level preparation preserves ListFormat UTF16 placeholders, separator suppression, unsupported level10 handling, unsigned-byte positions and signed16 geometry; RtfAttributeOutput writes original NFC/CJK-language, alignment, start, legal, follow, font/character properties and destinations. The browser command-rule assembler now supplies level-specific ListFormat instead of creating deprecated patternless numeric levels. Original character color/underline visitors run before header serialization to admit numbering-style colors; native accumulated automatic-style vector order and shared-handle release are preserved. New owned item sets are disposed. WRITER198 records retained adjacent separators. Common numbering preparation is currently bound to the actual RTF virtual output; full common AttributeOutputBase/DOCX numbering, graphic brush ownership, paragraph numbering/restart temporary-rule lifetimes, character-style table/cache and complete OutColorTable responsibilities remain unverified. This source-bound focused integration does not certify full upstream parity or filter completeness.
omittedResponsibilities: Full upstream character, page, section, drawing and field attribute vocabularies remain unverified.
